ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity pixel values (black/dark grey) across >95% of visible surface; low global contrast ratio with localized high-intensity pixels occurring only at the median notch and tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid low-intensity (black) contiguous region covering both lobes; distinct high-contrast white focal spots concentrated at the base of the median notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Approximate 120-degree shallow V-shaped depression at the central convergence of the lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serrations along the entire trailing edge; multiple distinct peaks and deep valleys exceeding 15-pixel depth relative to the mean edge line.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex upward sweep for both lobes terminating in sharp, well-defined tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast, roughly circular white/grey pixel clusters localized on the terminal tips (apexes) of both the left and right lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization and associated scarring visible on both fluke tips; significant jaggedness on the right lobe suggesting historic physical trauma.
